relationships.subject: gepants
relationships.evidence_quote: Gepants are small molecules that antagonize the CGRP receptor

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: two classes of drugs antagonizing CGRP have therefore been developed as the first migraine-specific preventive treatments: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and gepants

key_findings: Anti-CGRP mAbs (including galcanezumab) and gepants are effective migraine preventives.
